root_cause: The pinned pnpm 9.15.4 frozen install downloaded dependencies but the repository postinstall could not create the required plugin-sdk symlink and returned EPERM.
forbidden_recovery: Do not modify Paperclip source, scripts, lockfile, or dependencies to fit the test chain.
possible_external_recovery: Run on Windows with symlink creation enabled or on a supported Unix environment, then begin a fresh attempt.
